neutral.$description: Neutral grays ranging from off-white to near-black.

red.$description: Red hues ranging from pale coral to deep wine.

orange.$description: Orange hues ranging from pale peach to deep burnt orange.

yellow.$description: Yellow hues ranging from pale wheat to dark ochre.

green.$description: Green hues ranging from pale mint to dark emerald.

blue.$description: Blue hues ranging from pale periwinkle to rich cerulean.

purple.$description: Purple hues ranging from pale lavender to rich slate indigo.

pink.$description: Pink hues ranging from pale blush to dark plum.

spacing.$description: Spacing scale derived from size via sizeToSpace(). Same named steps as size.

font-size.$description: Tailwind CSS default font sizes and paired line heights (--text-*, --text-*--line-height)

letter-spacing.$description: Tailwind CSS default letter-spacing (tracking). em values mapped to rem per DTCG dimension units.

line-height.$description: Tailwind CSS default unitless line heights (leading)

inset-shadow.$description: Tailwind CSS default inset box shadows

drop-shadow.$description: Tailwind CSS default drop shadows (filter). Mapped to DTCG shadow type.

text-shadow.$description: Tailwind CSS default text shadows. Mapped to DTCG shadow type.

ease.$description: Tailwind CSS default cubic-bezier easing functions
